abilities.name: Innervate
abilities.text:
Grant an allied Hero 20% of their maximum Mana over 5 seconds. While affected by Innervate, their Basic Ability cooldowns recharge 50% faster.

Cannot be used on Heroes that do not use Mana.

abilities.name: Regrowth
abilities.text: Heal an allied Hero for 380 Health over 20 seconds.

abilities.name: Moonfire
abilities.text:
Deal 90 damage to enemies in an area and reveal them for 2 seconds.

Allies with an active Regrowth are healed for 130 Health for each enemy Hero hit by Moonfire.

abilities.name: Entangling Roots
abilities.text: Root enemy Heroes in an area for 1.25 seconds, and deal 117 damage over the duration. Affected area grows over 3 seconds.

abilities.name: Tranquility
abilities.text: Heal nearby allied Heroes for 80 Health per second for 8 seconds. Allies affected by Regrowth within Tranquility's area gain 10 Armor.

abilities.name: Twilight Dream
abilities.text: After 0.5 seconds, deal 310 damage in a large area around Malfurion, Silencing enemies making them unable to use Abilities for 3 seconds.

1.name: Deep Roots
1.text:
Entangling Roots grows 25% larger, and persist on the ground 40% longer.

Repeatable Quest: Every time an enemy Hero becomes Rooted, gain 14 Mana permanently.

1.name: Vengeful Roots
1.text:
Entangling Roots spawns a Treant that deals 58 damage per second and loses Health over 11 seconds.

Repeatable Quest: Hitting enemy Heroes with Entangling Roots permanently increases the Treant's Basic Attack damage by 7.

1.name: Emerald Dreams
1.text: Entangling Roots Sleeps enemy Heroes for 2 seconds after its Root expires.

4.name: Rejuvenation
4.text: Casting Regrowth on an ally also grants Malfurion its effect for 50% normal duration.

4.name: Celestial Alignment
4.text: Increase Moonfire's reveal duration by 3 seconds. Malfurion's Basic Attacks against Heroes revealed by Moonfire deal 85% more damage.

4.name: Shan'do's Clarity
4.text: Gain a second charge of Innervate. Its cooldown recharges 25% faster per ally affected by Regrowth.

7.name: Wild Growth
7.text: Each Hero hit by Moonfire extends the duration of currently active Regrowths by 1 second.

7.name: Tenacious Roots
7.text: Increase the Root duration of Entangling Roots by 25%. When Malfurion is Stunned, the cooldown of Entangling Roots is instantly reset. This can only occur every 10 seconds.

7.name: Nature's Cure
7.text: Activate to remove all Stuns, Roots, and Slows from allies affected by Regrowth.

10.name: Tranquility
10.text: Heal nearby allied Heroes for 80 Health per second for 8 seconds. Allies affected by Regrowth within Tranquility's area gain 10 Armor.

10.name: Twilight Dream
10.text: After 0.5 seconds, deal 310 damage in a large area around Malfurion, Silencing enemies making them unable to use Abilities for 3 seconds.

13.name: Nature's Swiftness
13.text: Malfurion gains 6% Movement Speed for every active Regrowth.

13.name: Hindering Moonfire
13.text: Moonfire Slows Heroes hit by 25% for 3 seconds.

13.name: Revitalize
13.text: Using Innervate also grants Malfurion 15% of his max Mana and causes his Basic Ability cooldowns to refresh 50% faster for 5 seconds.

16.name: Ysera's Gift
16.text: While Malfurion is above 75% Health, Regrowth's healing-over-time is increased by 75%.

16.name: Nature's Balance
16.text: Increase Moonfire's area by 25% and Regrowth's duration by 5 seconds.

16.name: Moonlit Harmony
16.text: Increase Moonfire's heal by 20%, and 15% per ally affected by Regrowth.

20.name: Serenity
20.text: Each enemy Hero hit by Moonfire reduces the cooldown of Tranquility by 3 seconds. Increase Tranquility's healing by 25% and 10% per ally affected by Regrowth.

20.name: Astral Communion
20.text:
Activate to Channel for 1 second, and then instantly teleport and cast Twilight Dream at the targeted location. Cooldown is shared with Twilight Dream.

Passive: Increase Twilight Dream's Silence duration to 5 seconds.

20.name: Lifebloom
20.text: Casting Regrowth instantly heals its target for 10% of their missing Health.

20.name: Lunar Shower
20.text: If Moonfire hits a Hero, its cooldown is reduced by 1 second and the next Moonfire within 6 seconds deals 20% more damage. This damage bonus stacks up to 60%.
